description:
Changes the authenticated player's display name using the matching user ID and current session.
Use when: the player explicitly confirms a new display name.
Not for: changing another player or account metadata. Use horizon_check_auth when session validity is uncertain.
Side effects: replaces the player's current display name, with the same session validation and idle-time renewal as check-auth.
Returns: AuthStatusResponse with isAuthenticated, authStatus and message. Check the response status/message to confirm the change.
Errors: 400 for a blank or over-50-character name. Invalid sessions return 200 with isAuthenticated=false and INVALID_CREDENTIALS; they do not update the name. Needs HORIZON_API_KEY. Every failure returns an error result (isError) with the HTTP status and body: a 401 that horizon_test_connection also returns means HORIZON_API_KEY is wrong, 429 means the account's per-minute rate limit was reached (wait a minute, then retry).

newName.description: New display name confirmed by the player, from 1 to 50 characters

sessionToken.description: Player accessToken from signup, signin or refresh-session, passed as sessionToken (max 256 characters)

userId.description: Player user ID (UUID) from the result of horizon_signup_* or horizon_signin_*

name: horizon_change_name
title: Change Player Name
